{'text': 'OpenAI宣布推出一項名為「ChatGPT小型企業計劃」的新計劃。與此同時，該公司亦宣布ChatGPT Work及Codex用戶已突破1000萬。', 'segments': [{'text': "OpenAI announces new 'ChatGPT for Small Business' plan, as it also reveals ChatGPT Work and Codex have crossed 10 million users."}]}

{'text': 'ChatGPT小型企業計劃', 'segments': [{'text': 'ChatGPT for Small Business'}]}

{'text': 'OpenAI表示，其全新的「ChatGPT小型企業計劃」是「一項旨在協助小型企業提升生產力，並透過ChatGPT擴展業務規模的計劃」。', 'segments': [{'text': 'OpenAI said its new \'ChatGPT for Small Business\' plan is "a program designed to help small businesses boost productivity and scale with ChatGPT."'}]}

{'text': '該計劃包含四個核心部分，包括：提供實作虛擬培訓、參加在美國舉辦的實體小型企業AI學院、實用的ChatGPT入門指南，以及使用專為小型企業打造的全新智能代理及合作夥伴服務。', 'segments': [{'text': 'The program has four main parts, including hands-on virtual training, attending in-person small business AI academies in the US, a practical guide to getting started with ChatGPT, and access to new agents and partner services built for small businesses.'}]}

{'text': 'OpenAI設有報名表格，小型企業可填寫以申請加入。', 'segments': [{'text': 'OpenAI has a form that small businesses can fill out to apply.'}]}

{'text': '你可按此了解更多有關OpenAI小型企業計劃的資訊。', 'segments': [{'text': "You can learn more about OpenAI's small business program here."}]}

{'text': 'ChatGPT Work及Codex用戶突破1000萬', 'segments': [{'text': 'ChatGPT Work and Codex cross 10M users'}]}

{'text': '此舉是公司整體推廣ChatGPT Work的一部分。ChatGPT Work是ChatGPT更具代理功能（agentic）的版本，可應用於超越聊天機械人對話的更廣泛生產力任務。', 'segments': [{'text': "This is part of the company's broader push of ChatGPT Work, an agentic version of ChatGPT that can be used for wider productivity tasks beyond chatbot conversations."}]}

{'text': 'ChatGPT Work及Codex用戶突破1000萬的里程碑，令Codex的用戶數量較7月初翻了一倍。', 'segments': [{'text': 'The 10 million user milestone for ChatGPT Work and Codex represents a doubling of Codex users since early July.'}]}

{'text': 'OpenAI本月以基於獨立Codex應用程式的版本取代其桌面應用程式，加入更多進階功能，同時亦令基本聊天介面變得更複雜。該應用程式其後經過數次更新，以在聊天與任務之間取得更佳平衡。', 'segments': [{'text': 'OpenAI this month replaced its desktop app with a version based on its standalone Codex app, adding more advanced features while also making the basic chat interface more complicated. The app has since received several updates to strike a better balance between chat and tasks.'}]}

  • {'text': 'OpenAI將終止其獨立桌面瀏覽器ChatGPT Atlas', 'segments': [{'text': 'OpenAI is shutting down its standalone desktop browser ChatGPT Atlas'}]}
